caseName: J. I. Case Co. v. Borak
caseNameFull: J. I. Case Co. v. Borak

opinions.text: Certiorari, 375 U. S. 901, to the United States Court' of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit. The motion of the Solicitor General, on behalf of the Securities and Exchange Commission, for leave to participate in oral argument, as amicus curiae, is granted, and fifteen minutes are allotted for that purpose.
